# GoalOracle

> Free FIFA World Cup 2026 prediction game. Users build a guided bracket — rank the four teams in each group, select the eight best third-placed teams, then fill the knockout bracket — in about ten minutes. Players join public or private leagues and compete on a global leaderboard ranked by accuracy. Free to enter (no purchase necessary, no gambling, no wagering). Top 3 finishers on the Global Quick Picks Leaderboard at the end of the World Cup Final receive cash prizes of $150 / $100 / $50 paid in USDC stablecoin. Prediction engine is compliant with the official FIFA World Cup 26 rulebook (including Annexe C third-place routing across all 495 combinations).

## Key facts

- **URL:** https://goaloracle.io
- **Tournament:** FIFA World Cup 2026
- **Kickoff:** 11 June 2026, 15:00 ET
- **Final:** 19 July 2026
- **Hosts:** United States, Canada, Mexico
- **Matches:** 104 total (48 group-stage + 16 Round of 32 + 8 Round of 16 + 4 Quarterfinals + 2 Semifinals + 1 Third-Place + 1 Final)
- **Teams:** 48 across 12 groups of 4
- **Format:** Top 2 from each group + 8 best third-placed teams advance to Round of 32; single-elimination from there
- **Cost:** Free to enter. No entry fee. No purchase necessary. Not gambling.
- **Prizes:** $150 / $100 / $50 in USDC stablecoin paid to the top 3 finishers on the Global Quick Picks Leaderboard at the end of the FIFA World Cup 2026 Final. Skill-based contest sponsored by Suraam, LLC d/b/a GoalOracle.
- **How to play:** Guided three-step bracket (rank groups, pick best thirds, fill knockouts). ~10 minutes. 209 total points: group rankings score 3 / 2 / 1 / 1 by finishing position (84), each of the 8 best-third picks is worth 2 (16), and knockout winners escalate by round — 2 in the Round of 32, 3 in the Round of 16, 5 in the quarterfinals, 8 in the semifinals, 5 in the third-place match, 12 in the final (109). The leaderboard ranks by accuracy (share of available points earned), with ties broken by earliest submission.
- **Result verification:** Dual-source oracle. Results are pulled from football-data.org and api-football.com, and both sources must agree before points are awarded. Disputes trigger admin review.
- **Authentication:** Email, Google, Twitter/X, or wallet (via Privy). An embedded wallet is created at signup for future features; no funds are collected from players.
- **Leagues:** Public (listed, open to all), private (invite-only with passcode), or scoped (specific groups or rounds only).
- **Sponsor:** Suraam, LLC d/b/a GoalOracle (Delaware LLC, registered office 131 Continental Dr, Suite 305, Newark, DE 19713).

## Annexe C — Third-place team routing

FIFA's Annexe C is the official routing matrix that determines which 8 of the 12 third-placed teams advance to the Round of 32, and which specific bracket slot each advancing team occupies. There are 495 possible combinations of qualifying third-placed teams. GoalOracle's prediction engine implements all 495 combinations exactly as published. The cross-group third-place tiebreaker order is: points → goal difference → goals scored → fair play points → FIFA ranking (no head-to-head, since these teams haven't played each other).
